name: calleval
description: AI call evaluation platform: pulls ElevenLabs and Retell AI calls, scores them against the Call Evaluation Framework and recommends fixes.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run calleval serve --reload
scripts.start: cd apps/api && uv run calleval serve
scripts.worker: cd apps/api && uv run calleval worker
scripts.seed:demo: cd apps/api && uv run calleval seed-demo
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:api
